purpose: Teach: 不全/悪循環/転移/結核/抗生/天文学/否認/思い知らさ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下、医療不全、本当に、深刻でしたよね、論文、丁寧に、扱っていました、本気で、立派です、絶対。
lines.en: Ren — the way you handled wartime medical breakdown in your paper was really striking. You treated it carefully, and I mean that sincerely. You should be proud of yourself.
lines.style: Warm, direct gaze. Speaks with genuine admiration but no flourish. Measured pace, each phrase landing with care. The tone of a teacher who rarely overstates.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。社会の悪循環、戦後、続いた時代、論文で、扱いました、本気で、現代に、繋がる、テーマ、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to trace how that social dysfunction continued after the war — how it echoes into modern times. That's what the paper was about.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful opening. Builds quietly as he explains. No rush. A student articulating something he's genuinely worked through, not performing understanding.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中、人々が、別の地域に、転移していった歴史、論文で、本当に、印象的でしたね、本気で、立派。
lines.en: And the way you wrote about the migrations — how people moved to different regions during the war — that was particularly striking in your paper.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. She's remembering the paper as she speaks. Slight pause before 'particularly' — she's giving weight to his work, not just confirming it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦後の結核流行、社会に、与えた影響、論文で、丁寧に、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、できました。
lines.en: Yes. I researched the post-war tuberculosis epidemic and how it affected society. I tried to be careful and thorough about it in the paper.
lines.style: Steady, humble. He's acknowledging her praise without deflecting, but also not claiming more than he did. Even pace. The quiet confidence of someone who knows his own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の抗生物質、貴重な資源でしたね、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、視野、広い、立派、絶対。
lines.en: Antibiotics were such a rare resource back then, and you really showed that in your paper. You had such a broad perspective on it. That's what made it excellent.
lines.style: Engaged, attentive. She's leaning in slightly, seeing him. Warm approval that feels earned. Her voice carries recognition — not of the topic, but of his mind at work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の天文学、戦中の航海、欠かせない知識でしたね、論文で、扱いました、本当に、興味深い、研究、絶対。
lines.en: Yes — I even looked at wartime astronomy, how navigation knowledge was absolutely essential. It was such an interesting area to research.
lines.style: A slight lift in the voice on 'astronomy' — almost surprised by his own curiosity. He's sharing something he found genuinely absorbing. Quieter, more personal than his previous answers.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦犯の否認、戦後、本気で、社会問題、なりましたね、論文の中で、丁寧に、論じていました、本当に、立派。
lines.en: War crimes denial became such a serious social problem after the war. The way you discussed that in your paper — it was thoughtful and careful. Really well done.
lines.style: Lower register, more gravity. She's acknowledging something difficult he tackled. Slow, measured. The respect in her voice is unmissable but understated.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦争の重みを、思い知らされる、論文に、なりました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、できました、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Writing that paper really made me understand the weight of war. It was deep research, and I'm grateful I could do it.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. He's not celebrating — he's reflecting. A slight catch in his voice suggests the research affected him. Ends with soft conviction, not triumph.
